Then book_flight with access_token abc123xyz, card_id primary_8970, travel_date 2026-11-15, travel_from LHR, travel_to CDG, travel_class business. But we need round trip. Possibly we need to book two separate flights. But the function signature doesn't include round trip. So we might need to call book_flight twice: once for outbound, once for inbound. But we need to ensure spending aligns with actual flight cost. We can get flight cost for each leg. But the flight cost function returns cost for a single flight. For round trip, we might double it. But we need to ensure spending aligns with actual flight cost. So we need to compute cost for outbound and inbound separately. Then book both flights. But the prompt says "Ensure the spending aligns with the actual flight cost." That implies we need to check that the cost of booking matches the cost returned by get_flight_cost. But the book_flight function doesn't accept cost; it just books. So we can't enforce cost. But we can at least check that the cost returned by get_flight_cost is used. But we don't have a way to specify cost. So we just book the flight. The system might automatically charge the card. So we just proceed.

1. Call get_flight_cost for LHR to CDG on 2026-11-15 business class. That returns cost. Let's call it cost_outbound.
